hero.pill: Wrestling camp in Dagestan and MMA in Chechnya
hero.subtitle: Training camp at the heart of the Caucasus. Wrestling in Dagestan, MMA in Chechnya. Just pack your bag, MKR handles everything.

audience_switcher.label: FOUR WAYS TO COME
audience_switcher.subtitle: Solo, duo, family or with your club? We have a format for every profile. Wrestling in Dagestan or MMA in Chechnya: visa, domestic flight from Istanbul, transfers, accommodation, meals and coaching are all coordinated on site by MKR.

card1.label: Heritage · Tradition · Combat
card1.body_part1_before_strong: The best fighters in the world all come from the same cradle: the Caucasus. The biggest names in MMA,
card1.body_part1_strong: hundreds of medalists and Olympic wrestling champions
card1.body_part1_after_strong: . No accident. Here, combat has been passed down
card1.body_part1_strong2: from father to son for centuries
card1.body_part2_before_strong: MKR Caucasian Camp opens this heritage to foreign athletes. Same gyms, same coaches, same methods. Not as a tourist. As an athlete here to
card1.body_part3_before_strong: When you return from your Caucasus camp (Wrestling in Dagestan or MMA in Chechnya, from one to three weeks), you no longer fight the same. You no longer train the same.
card1.body_part3_strong: And you no longer see yourself the same.

card2.label: Coaching · Methods · Progression
card2.body_before_strong: Daily sparring with local fighters. Technical work, controlled intensity, supervised recovery. The methods that built world champions

card3.label: Effort · Discipline · Brotherhood
card3.body_before_strong: You share their discipline through effort. Same rounds, same intensity, same soreness. Zero distraction, zero excess. Just the training, the Caucasian culture, and a
card3.body_after_strong: you will not find in any European gym.

facilitator_band.label: ALL INCLUSIVE
facilitator_band.subtitle: Visa, domestic flight, transfers, accommodation, meals and training: six services included in every camp, whichever format you choose. You only book your flight to Istanbul.

visa.title: Russian visa included
visa.desc: Consular fees, official invitation letter, EU questionnaire and full file management. You provide your passport, MKR runs the process.

flight.title: Domestic flight
flight.desc: From Istanbul to Makhachkala (Wrestling in Dagestan) or Grozny (MMA in Chechnya), included in the package. You only book your international flight to Istanbul.

transfers.title: Airport transfers
transfers.desc: MKR vehicle on arrival: about 1h30 from Makhachkala (Dagestan) or about 30 min from Grozny (Chechnya). All transfers are included.

accommodation.title: Accommodation
accommodation.desc: Comfortable camp lodging, family room available. You sleep and eat with your group.

meals.title: 2 meals per day
meals.desc: Breakfast and lunch included. Caucasian cuisine adapted to athletes: protein, vegetables, fresh bread.

coaching.title: Coaching staff
coaching.desc: Experienced local Coaches in Dagestan (Wrestling) and Chechnya (MMA). Dedicated youth Coach for ages 8-17 in Youth Wrestling.

facilitator_band.force_title: A TEAM IN FRANCE, LOCAL CONTACTS ON SITE
facilitator_band.force_text: All admin and networks are managed from France by a French-speaking team that takes your file from A to Z. On the ground, local contacts guide you through the gyms alongside Ruslan Mukhtarov, founder and Coach in Wrestling and MMA.
facilitator_band.footnote: You only have one thing to do: pack your bag. We handle the rest.

01.title: APPLICATION
01.body: You fill out the application form online. Current level, discipline, goals. We need to know who you are before confirming whether the camp is right for you.
01.img_alt: Fighter alone in the camp gym

02.title: INTERVIEW
02.body: A video call with our team. Not an interrogation, a conversation. We want to understand your motivations and tell you what truly awaits you on site.
02.img_alt: Applicant on a video interview from their space

03.title: CONFIRMATION
03.body: Call validated, package paid by bank transfer, contract signed. Your spot is reserved. We launch your remote preparation with the personalized pre-camp guide.

04.title: PREPARATION
04.body: Four weeks of remote protocol: tailored physical preparation, nutrition plan, Russian visa process. We use every day before your arrival.

05.title: IMMERSION
05.body: One to three weeks in Dagestan. Two training sessions per day, sparring with local fighters, life in community. You leave with a level you would never have reached elsewhere.
05.img_alt: Road to the camp in the Caucasus

contact.label: APPLICATION
contact.subtitle: Fifteen spots maximum per session. We accept motivated athletes with the basics down, not only pros. The video interview helps us understand your goals.

01.title: Form
01.desc: You fill out the application form online. Level, goals, experience.

02.title: Video interview
02.desc: A 15-minute call with our team to understand your motivation and level.

03.title: Confirmation
03.desc: Reply within 72h. If selected, you receive the full preparation guide.

04.title: Departure
04.desc: Airport transfer included. We pick you up on arrival. You have nothing to manage.
